fields.System.Title: Exporting a report over 10,000 rows produces an empty file with no error
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.TCM.ReproSteps:
Preconditions: signed in as a user with export permission; a saved report returning more than 10,000 rows.

  1. Open the saved report.
  2. Choose Export to CSV.
  3. Wait for the download to finish.

Actual: a 0-byte file downloads and the UI shows the success toast.

Expected: either the full file downloads, or the export fails with a message naming the row limit.

Frequency: every attempt above the limit; never below it.
